# Smartapp

> Smartapp (smartapp-agency.com) is an Israeli agency that builds mobile apps and web platforms with AI tools, founded and run by Samuel Driquez (סמואל דריקז). A first version (MVP) usually costs ₪15,000 to ₪25,000 and is built within up to 90 working days, including product spec, UI/UX design, full development, payments and App Store / Google Play submission. Clients work directly with Samuel from the first call to launch. Site language: Hebrew.

## What Smartapp builds
- Mobile apps for iOS and Android, web platforms, SaaS, marketplaces
- Business management systems, customer portals, internal dashboards
- AI based products, automation tools, subscription and payment systems
- Not offered: physical products, patents, work for equity or revenue share

## Who it is for
Entrepreneurs who want to launch and test an idea without a six figure budget, business owners who need a custom system, and people with no technical background.
